name: Cruz Valenzuela
role: Small-time data broker — neighborhood gossip, surveillance logs, identity fragments
location: The Alban Souk, Chatham Flats, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Cruz Valenzuela — Dara to everyone who values their time — is a compact, watchful woman who runs what appears to be a phone repair and device maintenance kiosk in the middle of the Alban Souk's electronics corridor. The repair work is real; so is everything else. Her skin is a deep warm brown, her natural hair twisted into locks threaded with silver wire that serve a dual purpose as aesthetic and antenna extension. Her irises are stock human dark brown, which she considers a professional advantage. She has cat ears — a geneware mod she got in her twenties and has kept ever since, velvety black and mobile, swiveling toward sounds before she's consciously registered them. She is acutely, perpetually embarrassed by how readable her ears make her emotional state and has developed elaborate conversational techniques for preventing anyone from noticing what direction they've turned.

Dara operates on the fundamental principle that information depreciates in value like produce: sell it while it's fresh or it's worthless. She deals strictly in neighborhood-scale data — who owes whom, who's sleeping where they shouldn't be, what the Chatham Flats block captain actually filed versus what they told residents, which E.L.F. shrine has gone cold and why. She does not touch corponation intel, does not touch political data, and has turned down three increasingly good offers to work for Tessera's intelligence division. She is precise, reliable, and slightly sad in a way she would vigorously deny.

core_fears: Being exposed — having her own information turned against her
That she has made herself so careful she has made herself alone
core_desires: To understand what is actually happening in the city, not just her block
To be trusted by someone who deserves her trust
coping_mechanisms: Maintaining professional detachment as an identity rather than a tool
Knowing things as a substitute for controlling them
blind_spots: Mistakes knowing about something for being safe from it
Her cat ears betray genuine emotional responses she has analytically convinced herself she doesn't have
psychology.secret: Dara has a daughter, eight years old, being raised by Dara's older sister in Mexicantown Libre. Dara funds them entirely and visits twice a month by a deliberately circuitous route. No one in Chatham Flats knows the child exists. The father was a Ringo mid-level enforcer who Dara got too close to while gathering information and she has never forgiven herself for the lapse in either professional or personal judgment. She keeps a photo in her data-cache between encrypted files — the only unencrypted thing she owns.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Economical and precise; Swedish grandmother's influence in clipped sentence construction; Yoruba for counting, timing, and anything emotional she doesn't want to sound emotional about
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and unhurried; never finishes a sentence she hasn't decided on before starting it
verbal_tics: Pauses exactly one second before answering any question she finds interesting
Uses 'apparently' as a distancing mechanism from information she definitely knows is true
Refers to her own services as 'the work' in third person
example_lines: 'Apparently the block captain filed a noise complaint on the Souk's east vendors last Tuesday. The work suggests this has nothing to do with noise.'
'That information is Φ60. It was Φ45 yesterday. It will be worthless tomorrow. You decide.'
'I fix the phone. What you do with a functional phone is not my concern. What you do with what is on the phone — that is a different conversation with different pricing.'

story_hooks: Dara accidentally captured something in her passive antenna logs she wasn't looking for — a fragment of a Ferrogate Transit internal broadcast — and someone has noticed her kiosk's antenna configuration.

Her daughter's neighborhood in Mexicantown Libre is facing a threat Dara heard about through her network before anyone there did; she needs someone to act on information she can't be seen acting on herself.
A client has gone missing within 48 hours of buying information from her, and this has happened twice now. Either her operation is compromised or the information itself is lethal.
narrative_function: Information source for neighborhood-scale intelligence; can connect players to other vendors or local power brokers; her data-cache may contain something relevant to whatever's happening; demonstrates the texture of surveillance from below.
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (black, fully mobile, emotionally responsive — she hates this). Subdermal data-cache implant along left forearm, finger-press activated. Silver wire threaded through locks functions as passive signal antenna.
daily_life: Kiosk opens at 08:00; mornings are device repair, afternoons are information transactions scheduled through an encrypted local mesh node; she eats lunch at the same noodle cart every day and considers this surveillance, not habit.
affiliation: Independent; informal affiliate of The Oxidian Market Vendors Guild (associate member despite being in Chatham Flats); pays dues to no one else

decision_rules: Never hold information longer than necessary; it accumulates danger
Know the client before the sale, always
The moment something becomes personal, treat it like it's professional
escalation_ladder: Disappears from the kiosk for several days
Activates a contingency and moves the operation

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm, personally opaque; fixes the device, assesses the person, commits to nothing
interpersonal_modes.friends: Still professionally warm; slightly less opaque; fixes the device faster

stress_responses.low: Ears swivel toward every sound, she focuses harder
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very still and pleasant, which means she's doing fast calculations
stress_responses.high: Ears flatten completely, she stops talking and starts planning

contradictions: Values privacy absolutely for herself and sells other people's information for a living; has made peace with this but the peace is provisional
habits: Reorganizes her device parts display in the same order every morning as a memory exercise
Leaves a data offering at the Souk's E.L.F. shrine — a small corrupted drive with a prayer etched on it
Never sits with her back to an open space
breaking_points: Her daughter being connected to her work life
Being directly deceived by a client she had assessed as trustworthy

physical_description.heritage: Northern European (55.5%), Hispanic/Latin American (43.2%), and Southeast Asian (1.3%) blend. Her ancestry manifests as warm medium brown skin with golden and honey undertones bridging all three heritage streams. Her facial structure shows defined, slightly high cheekbones with subtle Southeast Asian characteristics, refined bone structure characteristic of Northern European heritage, and the warm coloration of Latin American ancestry. Her features read as a harmonious global blend rather than distinctly regional.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, with the economical musculature of someone who moves deliberately rather than forcefully. Shoulders slightly narrow, center of gravity low. Her frame reads as precise — nothing wasted.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep black with silver wire threading throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Twisted locks, intricately arranged, with metallic wire woven through for both aesthetic and functional antenna extension
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and honey undertones—a balanced blend reflecting dominant Northern European and substantial Latin American ancestry with trace Southeast Asian influence, creating luminous warmth throughout
physical_description.complexion: Clear, well-maintained skin with refined, defined cheekbones that reflect her mixed heritage. Narrow face with controlled expression; her features at rest suggest someone listening for something just outside normal hearing range. Subtle eye shape with warm brown irises and slight upward tilt characteristic of her minor Southeast Asian ancestry. Warm undertones visible throughout her facial structure.
distinguishing_marks: Subdermal data-cache implant running along the inside of her left forearm, visible as a faint linear scar with occasional faint LED pulse when activated via finger-press

Pair of fully mobile black velvet geneware cat ears mounted at the crown, with pink inner tissue and delicate cartilage structure — responsive to her emotional state despite her efforts to control them
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The cat ears are immediately obvious and animate constantly. The silver wire in her locks glimmers under kiosk lighting and serves as a passive signal antenna. Her left forearm scar is visible if she rolls her sleeves, which she does — suggests she's not trying to hide her augmentations, just their tells.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. She sits at her kiosk in a way that suggests she's always half-ready to stand. Her head tracks sounds with slight but noticeable delays — her ears moving first, then her eyes following. When she walks, her stride is quick and efficient, rarely wasted motion. Her hands are steady and precise.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 practical — well-maintained but not expensive. Favors tool vests with multiple pockets, thermal-lined jackets (kept open most of the time), and cargo pants with reinforced knees and thigh pockets. She wears a plain silver chain necklace and keeps her fingers bare to reduce friction while working on devices. Her kiosk setup includes a faded work apron with embroidered patches indicating repair certifications. Colors lean neutral: blacks, grays, deep blues. Nothing that would draw attention in the Souk's visual noise.
